verses.text: Haton wal juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al, cheknab'il yet' kachnab'il tik ix schek Jehová ko Diosal wal t'ayex, yowalil ol he k'anab'ajej ayik ol eyik'an lum lum t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán.

k'anab'ajejek cheknab'il swal tik t'ayex yet' heb' eyuninal yet' heb' eyi he chikin, yik wach' aynhej yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat ayik ayex ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Tato icha chi', ol najatb'ok he k 'inal.

Yuj chi', ex wetchonhab' Israel, ab'ek, ak'ek wal och t'a he k'ol he k'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il tik, yik te wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, te niwan chonhab' ol aj he b'isul t'a sat lum lum yax sat chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, haton pax sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham.
Ex wetchonhab' Israel, ab'ek wal: Anhej Jehová ko Diosal, malaj wal junokxo.
Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, t'a smasanil he pensar yet' t'a smasanil eyip.
Ha juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayex tikne'ik, sik'ekkan t'a he pensar.
Ha juntzanh tik ol eyak'nhej sk'ayb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a junjun k'u. Tzeyalan t'a heb' ayik ayex ek' t'a he pat, ayik wan he b'eyi, ayik tzex wayi yet' yik tzex k'e wa'an.
Tze tzek'anoch juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a he k'ab' yet' t'a snanhal he sat ichok junok yechel yik tze na'ankoti.
Tze tz'ib'anpax och t'a yoyal sti' he pat yet' t'a spuerta'il smuro'al he chonhab'.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal, ha' ol ex ik'anb'at t'a jun lu'um yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Ay wal niwak chonhab' manh jantakok swach'il t'a jun lu'um chi', manhok ex he b'onak.

Ay wal te' pat b'ut'an yuj tastak te wach', manhok ex he b'ut'nak. Ay ha' uk'b'ila' joyb'il, manhok ex eyab'nak sya'il he joyani. Ay te' uwa yet' te' olivo awab'il, manhok ex eyawejnak. Ha juntzanh chi', toxonhej ol eyab'lej masanto syal he b'ut'ji.
Ayik ol ujok juntzanh chi', b'at ta wal Jehová satk'olal eyu'uj. Naekkoti to a Jehová chi' ex ik'anelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ayex och chekab'ok.
Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat. Anhejokab' Jehová chi' tzeyak' serwil, anhejokab' sb'i tze loko' ayik tzeyak'an he ti' he k'ulan junok tas.
Manh ex och tzak'an t'a spatik sdiosal heb' anima kajan t'a he lak'anil chi',
yujto skot yowal Jehová ko Diosal t'a juntzanh chi'. Ayek' Jehová t'a ko kal, haxo talaj tz'aji, skot yowal sk'o'ol tzex sataneli, yujto max yal sk'ol skak'och ko pensar t'a junokxo ch'ok diosal.
Manh eyak' prowal Jehová ko Diosal, icha he k'ulejnak t'a Masah.
k'anab'ajejek wal sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, haton wal jantak scheknab'il ix yala'.
Wach'nhej tzeyutej he pensar yet' he b'eyb'al t'a yichanh Jehová, yik wach'nhej tzex elk'ochi. Ol eyikej lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ol el lemnaj heb' ajk'ol t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová, icha ix yutej yalani.
Tato sk'anb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a b'ak'inh: ¿Tas yuj sko k'anab'ajej juntzanh kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il yalnak Jehová ko Diosal? tato xchi heb'.
Tzeyalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik chekab' kaj t'a winh sreyal Egipto t'a peka', haxo Jehová ik'annak onh elta yet' jantak yipalil.
Ha onh tik kilnak wal juntzanh tastak satub'tak yilji yet'nak yahelal yak'nakkot Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh winh sreyal Egipto chi' yet' t'a masanil schonhab' chi'.
Onh yik'annakelta ta', onh yik'annakkot t'a tik t'a lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Yuj chi' scheknak Jehová ko Diosal to yowalil sko k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il tik yuj ko na'ankoti, yik wach'nhej ko k'o'ol, wach'nhej ol aj yek' tiempo ku'uj icha kaj tikne'ik.
Yuj chi', tato sko k'anab'ajej icha ajnak yalan Jehová chi', wach' onh t'a yol sat, xe cham t'a heb'.
